form_plan.primary_theme_description: Haunting minor-key melody over driving 8-bit bass and arpeggios, evoking Polish sci-fi 80s soundtracks.

sections.description: Main mysterious theme in A minor with tense arpeggios.
Tense contrasting section in D minor with pad and driving bass.
Climactic return of theme an octave higher with energetic arpeggios.

intent.composition_notes: Polish sci-fi 80s influence: driving 8-bit bass, haunting leads, arpeggiated tension, and sparse percussion. Uses 4 channels with dynamic contrast.
